title: foundation-identity contract v1

secrets.description: secret names this identity may read at runtime

secret_ids.description: versionless Key Vault secret IDs (never values)

description: Output of foundation/identity. identities keys: hello-bff, hello-orders-api, hello-inventory-api, hello-catalog-api, hello-dbadapter, hello-worker, hello-durable, hello-functions, hello-jobs, hello-partner-sim, hello-traffic, hello-frontend, obs-collector, obs-dbm, aks-control-plane, aks-kubelet, deploy-agent (+ settings.extra_identities). secret_ids keys: datadog-api-key, datadog-app-key, fault-token, datadog-client-token, dbm-<engine>-password for engines in settings.dbm_sql_auth_engines (default mysql, sqlvm).
